title: TraceCAD: Trace-Guided Repair for Agentic CAD Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.03062v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based CAD agents produce executable parametric programs, but their correction loops may lose evidence about satisfied requirements, faulty operations, and prior repairs. We introduce TraceCAD, a recovery layer that links requested features, modeling steps, failure evidence, and candidate outcomes as persistent state. TraceCAD diagnoses likely faulty operations, searches bounded edits in their dependency regions, validates candidates through execution and preservation checks, and retains successful and failed repair outcomes in reusable skill memory. On DeepCAD-derived benchmarks with 200-model ablations and a 1K-model comparison, TraceCAD achieves competitive geometric quality in terms of IoU, Chamfer distance, and Hausdorff distance. Removing persistent state nearly halves recovery score; removing localized search more than doubles geometric regression and doubles code-agent invocations. Initializing the skill store on disjoint

translated_title: TraceCAD：面向智能体CAD生成的轨迹引导修复方法
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的CAD智能体能够生成可执行的参数化程序，但其纠错循环可能会丢失关于已满足的需求、错误操作以及先前修复的证据。我们提出了TraceCAD，一个将请求的特征、建模步骤、失败证据和候选修复结果链接为持久状态的恢复层。TraceCAD诊断可能出错的建模操作，在其依赖区域内搜索有界编辑方案，通过执行验证和保留性检查来评估候选方案，并将成功与失败的修复结果保存到可复用的技能记忆中。在基于DeepCAD的基准测试上，通过200个模型的消融实验和1000个模型的对比，TraceCAD在IoU、Chamfer距离和Hausdorff距离等指标上取得了具有竞争力的几何质量。消融实验表明，移除持久状态会使恢复分数几乎减半；移除局部化搜索会使几何退化增加一倍以上，并使代码智能体的调用次数翻倍。在不相交的数据上初始化技能库……
tldr: TraceCAD通过将需求、建模步骤、失败证据与修复结果链接为持久轨迹状态并配合可复用的技能记忆，实现对LLM生成的CAD程序的高效诊断与局部化修复，显著减少几何退化并大幅降低智能体调用开销。
en_tdlr: TraceCAD is a trace-guided recovery layer that maintains persistent state linking requested features, modeling steps, failure evidence, and repair outcomes—supported by reusable skill memory—enabling efficient diagnosis and localized repair of LLM-generated CAD programs while significantly reducing geometric regression and agent invocations.
